description: §52.13 (S449, g-auth-attr-invalid-or-dynamic-value-compiles-to-no-auth) — a NON-literal `<program auth=@mode>` is not one of the three accepted literals and applies no auth gate; it now emits W-ATTR-002 stating that effect. Before S449 this shape (and `auth=${…}`, bare `auth`) compiled with NO diagnostic at all to a public app. It is not treated as a gate: no W-AUTH-LOGIN-MISSING.
rationale: §52.13: 'The `auth=` attribute … accepts exactly three literal values'. §52.13.2: 'On a `<program>`, an unrecognized value applies no auth gate at all' and 'silent acceptance of attribute values that have no compile-time effect is itself a P0 finding'. The runtime half (the program serving publicly) is deliberately NOT pinned: whether this should instead be a compile error is an open ruling (docs/changes/s449-auth-session-fail-open/progress.md).
